Granny Gear look — v12

Dark base. Yellow on Home, sign-in, Sensors, Settings; Granny Gear blue on the Training screen (in session). Heart rate rolls on white graph paper with a live needle; the chip icons are live too: pedal spins at the cadence, speed needle sweeps, bolt flashes with power, heart beats at the heart rate (all animated here as in the app). Icons are white strokes; the coloured left borders from v2 come back on the Home tiles. Charts are smoothed with a soft fill and a live dot. Login takes a username only: no recent riders, no Add rider (both live on the platform). Background: generated studio photo with 300 Pro-style bikes; a real photo of the room can replace it.
